ros_decision_node_2hz.includes: rclpy timer + WorldState decode + DecisionEngine.step (incl. 2027 posture/spin & hit immediate trigger) + SentryRefereeCmd/spin publish + JSONL trace

notes: Model timings are pure NumPy float32 single-step forward passes (NumpyNavigationPolicy.predict, v2 85->6 joint navigation+posture; v1 73->2 MLP is 6.4/17.8 us, 534.6 KiB) without PyTorch or CUDA. ROS node footprint is measured on ROS 2 Jazzy (3.7% normalized to 2.0 Hz; 4.4% including periodic hit-triggered immediate re-decisions at 2.4 Hz).
